Fully modified HP filter of many series

Source: R/batch.R
fmhp_batch.Rd

fmhp_batch() applies fmhp_filter() to every column of a matrix or data frame, as mhp_batch() does for the modified HP filter.

Usage

fmhp_batch(
  X,
  max_lambda = 3000L,
  k_linear = 15L,
  k_quadratic = NULL,
  alpha_linear = seq(0, 2000, 10),
  alpha_quadratic = seq(0, 2000, 5),
  schemes = c("linear", "quadratic"),
  form = c("rows", "differences"),
  lambda = NULL,
  log_scale = TRUE
)

# Default S3 method
fmhp_batch(
  X,
  max_lambda = 3000L,
  k_linear = 15L,
  k_quadratic = NULL,
  alpha_linear = seq(0, 2000, 10),
  alpha_quadratic = seq(0, 2000, 5),
  schemes = c("linear", "quadratic"),
  form = c("rows", "differences"),
  lambda = NULL,
  log_scale = TRUE
)

Arguments

X

a numeric matrix or data frame, one series per column; missing values only at the start or the end.

max_lambda

the largest \(\lambda\) of the searches over \(1, 2, \dots,\) max_lambda (default 3000, as in the published code).

k_linear

number of end values with linear weights (default 15).

k_quadratic

number of end values with quadratic weights (default NULL: \(\mathrm{round}(\min(22, T/2 - 5))\)).

alpha_linear, alpha_quadratic

the grids of the weight \(\alpha\) (defaults seq(0, 2000, 10) and seq(0, 2000, 5)).

schemes

the schemes compared: c("linear", "quadratic") (default) or one of them.

form

"rows" (default, the published code) or "differences"; see Details.

lambda

NULL (default: chosen from the data) or a fixed smoothing parameter.

log_scale

filter the logarithm of the series (default TRUE, as in the published code).

Value

A data.table with the columns series, t, original, trend, cycle and the attribute lambdas, a data.table with series, lambda, gcv, lambda_mhp, scheme, alpha, k and loss.

See also

fmhp_filter, mhp_batch, plot_batch

Author

Muhammad Yaseen (myaseen208@gmail.com)

Examples

data(us_macro)
X <- as.matrix(us_macro[, c("gdp", "consumption", "investment")])
fb <-
  fmhp_batch(
      X               = X
    , max_lambda      = 3000
    , k_linear        = 15
    , k_quadratic     = NULL
    , alpha_linear    = seq(from = 0, to = 2000, by = 10)
    , alpha_quadratic = seq(from = 0, to = 2000, by = 5)
    , schemes         = c("linear", "quadratic")
    , form            = "rows"
    , lambda          = NULL
    , log_scale       = TRUE
    )
attr(x = fb, which = "lambdas")
#>         series lambda          gcv lambda_mhp    scheme alpha     k      loss
#>         <char>  <int>        <num>      <int>    <char> <num> <int>     <num>
#> 1:         gdp   1448 0.0003335623        683 quadratic    15    22 0.6163442
#> 2: consumption   1261 0.0002248243        534 quadratic    15    22 0.5850792
#> 3:  investment   2961 0.0073465762       1009 quadratic    20    22 0.6728679
